summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Keep the gated product private. Continue bounded read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, attribution, and security evidence work; keep external permission outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private. Official API documentation establishes access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data. Current terms point against the proposed public/commercial use. Security, accuracy/freshness, privacy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth across the managed fleet is conditional where existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Fleet compliance remains a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics is broadly available with permission gaps; revenue covers one day with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not treat aggregate revenue as site-attributed or infer legal clearance from technical passes.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence is recorded for official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because the required authoritative rights, field-level provenance, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and human-counsel review are incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep permission outreach unsent and keep the private gate unchanged pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, storage/derivative/caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate or advertising permission. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Do not close compliance, data-quality, analytics, revenue, site, or launch-readiness gates from aggregate evidence. Preserve site-specific unknowns and failures, including consent/banner findings, privacy/terms findings, network-unknown checks, analytics permission errors, and aggregate revenue attribution. Domain names and portfolio labels do not establish adult status, age suitability, regulated-use compliance, claims support, copyright/trademark clearance, data provenance, or platform-policy compliance. Continue existing source-dated measurement, failure repair-or-close review, bounded security evidence, and private launch-gate work only; create no new production work, duplicate telemetry request, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach.
